title: The past-ruling check retries once before it refuses on a timeout
why: The owner asked (page ask ask-mw6pwif5wv, 12:09 CST Nov 7) what caused raw Unvetted-guard text to reach him. The past-ruling check (hooks/call_judge.py, item 8) timed out on its model call and refused at once.
note:
Owner, page ask 13:18 CST Nov 7 (ask-mw6sdbes7t): why has the past-ruling check timed out more often lately? Read 13:28 CST: it is one Sonnet call with a fixed 15 s limit (PAST_RULING_TIMEOUT, hooks/call_judge.py, unchanged since Nov 2), and it runs on every question and every page decision write. Since Nov 2 the decision store gained 26 records (183 now), page items carry longer context, and sessions write far more page items. How often it times out is unmeasured here: the cloud container has no guard.log. Done check also: log each timeout with its prompt size, so the rate has a reader.
Done check: a red test where the first model call times out and the second answers; the question passes with the verdict and no Unvetted remedy. Lane started 12:20 CST Nov 7 (coordinator).
